From Rolling Stones · Price: only one mark at a time (two at 13th), and it fades if you mark another.

Theme Fate

  • 1: 1 action: mark a creature within 30 ft (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates); it gains weakness 1 to all damage for 1 round.
  • 5: Surge: the mark lasts 1 minute.
  • 9: Weakness 2.
  • 13: Two marks.
  • 17: Weakness 3.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.YCtIbeCXNkdOetfw]{Effect: Doom Mark}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
